item.title: Pike County native Matt Heffner gearing up for next fight
item.description: Pike County’s top-ranked amateur flyweight Matt Heffner puts his 9-0 record on the line Feb. 14 vs. 6-1 Emilio “The Mad Man” Barco at Tallahassee Combat Night.

item.title: Former Trojans Jones, Pettus set to live their dreams in Super Bowl
item.description: Former Troy Trojans Marcus Jones and Dell Pettus, now Patriots teammates, will face the Seahawks in Super Bowl LX after contributing on defense and special teams throughout 2025.

item.title: Pike County Relay for Life Pageant crowns 2026 winners
item.description: The ninth Pike County Relay for Life Pageant raised over $13,000 for the American Cancer Society and crowned 6-year-old Ellie Golden as Miss Spirit of Relay and Little Miss.

item.title: Troy Police Department executes narcotics search warrant
item.description: Troy police seize 3+ pounds of marijuana in Pace Street raid; 29-year-old Brandon Maddox charged with trafficking, held in Pike County Jail on $50,000 bond.

item.title: John Robert Lewis Leadership Conference Feb. 6-7
item.description: Troy University and the City of Troy will present the 2026 John Robert Lewis Leadership Conference February 6-7 on the main campus of Troy University. The conference, now in its 22nd year, seeks to bring individuals together to promote dialogue that fosters multicultural collaboration to strengthen relationships and empower diverse leaders with the tools to better serve their organizations and communities. item.title: Troy Men, Women earn Wednesday hoops victories
item.description: Troy’s men snapped a two-game skid at Georgia State and the women earned a fourth straight win over App State on Wednesday, giving both Trojans teams key Sun Belt victories.

item.title: Troy Softball Preview: New look Trojans hungry for a championship
item.description: After major roster overhaul and key transfers, Troy softball enters 2026 season hungry for its first Sun Belt title, aiming to defy a ninth-place preseason projection.

item.title: Child Predator Death Penalty Act passes Alabama Senate
item.description: Alabama lawmakers pass Child Predator Death Penalty Act, making some sexual crimes against children under 12 capital offenses punishable by death; bill now heads to the governor.
